# 00000007811

**English.** Definition: The tautological ring R^*(M_g) of M_g is generated by the kappa and lambda classes, and the Faber conjecture asserts that its socle concentrates in degree g-2 with a perfect pairing. Conjecture: The dimension of the space of alternating relations in R^*(M_g) equals the dimension of the alternating second cohomology of M_g; and the kernel of the natural map R^*(M_g) to A^*(M_g) is nontrivial for g at least 8, its smallest nontrivial relation occurring in degree g-4. (tautological-to-Chow kernel of M_g)

**中文。** 定义：M_g 的重言环 R^*(M_g) 由 κ 与 λ 类生成，Faber 猜想断言其 socle 集中于度 g-2 且配对完美。猜想：R^*(M_g) 的交错关系空间的维数等于 M_g 的交错第二上同调的维数；且重言环到 Chow 环的映射 R^*(M_g)→A^*(M_g) 的核当 g≥8 时非平凡，其最小非平凡关系出现在度 g-4 层。
